valueStateModel.rule: Do not coerce missing/suppressed/unverified into zero; value state is independent from measure kind.

geography.buildingIdStability: Order-based within this source release; never use as cross-release permanent cadastral identifier.

grainGuardrails: Supply register aggregates exist at tambon grain only; LAO has no register supply total.
Cars registrations are province grain only; never distribute provincial EV share to tambons or use as charging-demand observations.
Population/factories/hotel rooms are contextual proxy weights, not official counts or eligibility.
Building energy and area energy are modelled; geometry is source observation, not measured energy.
District values are calculated from tambon sums except population and source building counts; no silent cross-grain substitution.

Government rooftop-solar list (supply.govSolar) has no address, tambon or coordinates: district is inferred from the agency name for 9 records (2 via LAO names), 2 are province-only; never place it on the map, sum it into tambon supply, or divide it by the plan total of 113.

securityAcceptance: Server derives actor and workspace membership; never trust client-supplied role.
All reads/writes scoped by workspace and tested across two tenants.
Reject stale expectedRevision; preserve both revisions for review.
Idempotency key yields one record and one audit/outbox event.
Private media object store denies public/anonymous access; expiry is not consent.
Rights-cleared public projection is built separately; raw records never become frontend assets.
Coordinate release requires per-record rights, provenance and review; no inference from public web availability.
Provision exactly 5 owner-authorized users: Admin 1, Editor 2, Viewer 2; require explicit account identity bindings before provisioning.
Only role seat counts differ from Yolk: Admin1/Editor2/Viewer2; inherit all Yolk role permissions verbatim.
Test all 5 users plus anonymous/revoked/wrong-workspace. Viewer can keep a self-only draft but cannot Apply or write shared records, create ShareGrant or widen audience.
Admin/member changes preserve the last Admin as required by the inherited Yolk implementation task.

inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.admin: Manage workspace/members/custom field definitions plus editor actions

inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.viewer: Read permitted data, maps/details/feed; personal filters/theme/locale and notification read state; no shared writes
inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.checks: Tenant+role+entity scope at every API/storage/signed URL/share path; do not trust actor selectors or client canEdit
inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.viewerPrivateDraft: Permitted self-only preview/draft, never Apply/shared mutation
inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.reviewer: Assigned capability within editor/admin, not an extra seat role
inheritedPermissionsVerbatim.viewerForwarding: May copy/forward an existing link only within its authorized audience. Cannot create a new ShareGrant or grant new access.

userConfiguration.separationRule: Use the exact Yolk role permissions; only seat counts change. Permissions never replace data-rights approvals or source evidence.

meaningfulTests: Baseline same-release totals and queue outputs remain unchanged after identity/map changes.
Zero/no-data/suppressed fixtures never share the same analytical treatment.
Invalid view, codes, metric and percentile URLs recover without exceptions.
Changing basemap/theme keeps Demand membership, selection and saved criteria.
Provider failure preserves list workflow; navigation and focus work by keyboard.
Shortlist storage denied shows temporary persistence; CSV formula text cannot execute.
Narrow and desktop Thai/English actual content has no overlap; visible keyboard focus; no decorative bracket/colored left rail.
Icons/favicons/social image return correct bytes, MIME and dimensions at live canonical URL.
Public output excludes prohibited datasets and credentials.
Production-specific tests are pending until backend exists; never claim pass from static demo.
acceptance.testEvidence: Final release QA/byte-parity receipts bound to source SHA; prior counts are historical only.
